connector.name: Bitbucket MCP by FabianSchurig
connector.registryDescription: Bitbucket Cloud MCP in Go: complete API auto-generated from spec, customizable prompts.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the container image bitbucket-mcp:0.18.5. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the fabianschurig account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BITBUCKET_USERNAME
env.description: Your Bitbucket username/ email (required for Basic auth, omit for workspace/repo access tokens)

env.name: BITBUCKET_TOKEN
env.description: Your Bitbucket API token or OAuth2 access token
